_note: Fix-commit references only (no third-party code stored). 'files' = changed non-test .java files at that commit. 'auto_label' is a message-keyword guess (D=dupe, G=exploit/bypass, C=crash), NOT a verified paradigm. 'source: manual' cases were added by hand (the keyword filter missed them) and carry an 'expect' list = rules that should show a fixed-signal. 'split': 'tuning' = repos whose results were used to adjust the rules; 'holdout' = repos added afterwards and never used for tuning.
